sourceCommitNote: Host-confirmed git SHA of the mounted repository at verification time. environment.json gitCommit was null inside the container because git refused the bind-mounted .git directory (dubious ownership); the host checkout was verified as this SHA before and after the run.

playwright.browserBinaryPolicy: Playwright-managed binaries only; no system-browser override is accepted by this workflow.

execution.how: Official Playwright Docker image bind-mounted the repository at /work; isolated HOME=/tmp and npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm-cache; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright; ran npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund, npm run build, then npm run browser:verify (node scripts/browser-verification.mjs) inside the container.
execution.mobileSafariNote: mobile-safari is Playwright WebKit with iPhone 13 device emulation only. Chart zoom on Mobile Safari uses labeled public API chart.zoom (API zoom), not native pinch-to-zoom, because Playwright rejects mouse.wheel on mobile WebKit.
